text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $63k while Ethereum has dipped slightly harder at -0.6%, suggesting mild underperformance of alts despite stable majors. The Fear & Greed index at 27 signals genuine market anxiety, though the +12 rise over a week indicates some recovery from deeper fear, with volume at $87B reflecting moderate participation rather than capitulation selling. Bitcoin's dominance at 55.8% remains elevated, typical when sentiment weakens and traders rotate toward the perceived safer major asset.
